title: South Africa vs Zimbabwe Live Scorecard: Proteas Edge Chevrons in Windhoek Thriller
summary: Get the complete South Africa vs Zimbabwe cricket scorecard, key metrics, and match analysis from the thrilling 2nd T20I in Windhoek on August 29, 2026.
content:
The intense cricketing rivalry of south africa vs zimbabwe delivered another classic encounter on August 29, 2026, as the two southern African nations clashed in the 2nd T20I of the bilateral series at the United Ground in Windhoek. In a high-stakes encounter that kept fans on the edge of their seats, South Africa managed to level the series with a thrilling victory, narrowly defending their total against a spirited Zimbabwean run chase.

After losing the opening fixture, the Proteas entered this match under immense pressure. However, a disciplined bowling performance in the death overs secured a crucial win, leaving the series perfectly poised for the final decider. According to the official Cricinfo scorecard, South Africa's tactical adjustments in the middle overs proved to be the ultimate differentiator on a dry, spin-friendly Windhoek pitch.

Match Summary: SA vs ZIM 2nd T20I at Windhoek

Winning the toss and electing to bat first, South Africa posted a competitive total on a sluggish surface. Despite losing early wickets to Zimbabwe's disciplined new-ball attack, a stabilizing partnership in the middle overs propelled the Proteas to a defendable score. Zimbabwe’s chase started with explosive intent, but key wickets at crucial junctures derailed their momentum, leaving them just short of the target in a dramatic final over.

"We knew 175 was a competitive score on this surface, but we had to bowl exceptionally well in the final five overs. The boys showed incredible character under pressure to secure this win." — South African Captain

Key Match Statistics & Scorecard Metrics

  • South Africa First Innings: 174/6 in 20 overs (Ryan Rickelton 64 off 41 balls, Tristan Stubbs 42 off 28 balls; Richard Ngarava 3/28)
  • Zimbabwe Second Innings: 168/8 in 20 overs (Sikandar Raza 52 off 34 balls, Wessly Madhevere 38 off 25 balls; Gerald Coetzee 3/22, Keshav Maharaj 2/24)
  • Result: South Africa won by 6 runs
  • Player of the Match: Gerald Coetzee (SA) for his match-winning spell of 3/22
  • Series Status: 3-Match Series tied at 1-1

How the Match Was Won: Innings Breakdown

Proteas Recover to Post Defendable Target

South Africa's innings started on a shaky note as Zimbabwe's opening bowlers extracted early bounce and movement. However, opener Ryan Rickelton anchored the innings with a brilliant, calculated half-century. Alongside Tristan Stubbs, the duo put on a vital 78-run partnership for the fourth wicket. Zimbabwe's Richard Ngarava was the pick of the bowlers, utilizing clever variations to restrict South Africa from crossing the 190-run mark.

Zimbabwe's Brave Chase Falls Agonizingly Short

In reply, Zimbabwe began their chase aggressively, capitalizing on loose deliveries in the powerplay. Veteran all-rounder Sikandar Raza played a captain's knock, smashing a brilliant 52 to keep the Chevrons ahead of the required run rate. However, the introduction of Gerald Coetzee in the death overs turned the game. Coetzee claimed two wickets in the 18th over, giving away just 4 runs, which ultimately choked the Zimbabwean chase and sealed the win for South Africa.

Key Questions Answered (FAQs)

Who won the South Africa vs Zimbabwe T20I on August 29, 2026?

South Africa won the match by 6 runs, successfully defending their total of 174/6 by restricting Zimbabwe to 168/8 in their allocated 20 overs.

Where was the 2nd T20I match played?

The 2nd T20I match between South Africa and Zimbabwe was hosted at the United Ground in Windhoek, Namibia.

Who was the player of the match?

South African fast bowler Gerald Coetzee was named Player of the Match for his decisive spell of 3 wickets for 22 runs, which proved crucial in the death overs.
